# ACEs Too High

> > ACEs Too High educates the public and policymakers about Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs) and Positive Childhood Experiences (PACEs) science, translating research into actionable solutions for trauma-informed policy and community healing.

Founded by Jane Ellen Stevens, ACEs Too High is an independent nonprofit news organization dedicated to covering the science of how childhood adversity affects lifelong health and the evidence-based interventions that work. The site combines educational resources, research analysis, and investigative journalism to advance trauma-informed approaches across health, criminal justice, and social services.

## Key Topics

- Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs)
- Positive Childhood Experiences (PACEs)
- PACEs science
- Childhood trauma
- Trauma-informed care
- ACEs research
- Family violence prevention
- Batterer intervention programs
- CDC-Kaiser Permanente ACE Study
- Healing-centered approaches
- Nonprofit journalism
- Policy advocacy
- Community health
- Opioid prevention
- Child welfare

## Getting Started

- [About – ACEs Too High](https://acestoohigh.com/about-2): ACEsTooHigh LLC mission: educate about ACEs/PACEs research and implementation
- [PACEs Science 101 – ACEs Too High](https://acestoohigh.com/aces-101): Educational guide explaining PACEs science and CDC-Kaiser Permanente ACE Study
- [Resources – ACEs Too High](https://acestoohigh.com/resources): Curated resource center linking to PACEs science, policy, advocacy, and parenting
